title: Quickstack & Findme
description: Inventory includes a button to quickstack to nearby chests, similar to terraria!
It can also be keybound to quickly do so
(I really recommend not enabling or binding the dump key)
Adds a "find in nearby inventories" keybind
hovering an item in inventory or recipe viewer then pressing it will highlight nearby storages containing the item
Also adds a keybind to pull 1/64 of the item, without having to open the storages
